title: DE-4/2022/A1 - Departmental Examination for Junior Members of I.A.S., I.P.S. and I.F.S. - December, 2021 - Division 'B1' (Lower Standard) - Penal Code - Special and Local Criminal Laws (without books-30, with books-90)
questions: (Part A, answer any three) 1. "All murders are culpable homicides but all culpable homicides are not murder." Explain.
(Part A) 2. Describe the procedure relating to the trial of cases before the Court of Sessions.
(Part A) 3. State briefly the various offences described under the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988.
(Part A) 4(a) Examine the power of Magistrate to grant interim and ex-parte orders under the Protection of Woman from Domestic Violence Act, 2005.
(Part A) 4(b) When and for what purpose a Magistrate can pass a protection order infavour of aggrieved person?
(Part B, answer any nine) 5. Answer the following: (a) What you mean by offence?
5(b) Distinguish between bailable offence and non-bailable offence.
5(c) Distinguish between cognizable offence and non-cognizable offence.
6(a) Write a short note on the temporary release of person detained under the National Security Act, 1980.
6(b) What are the powers of the Central and State Government to regulate place and conditions of detention under the National Security Act, 1980?
7(a) Examine the ingredients of kidnapping from lawful guardianship and distinguish it from abduction.
7(b) Distinguish between wrongful restraint and wrongful confinement.
8(a) Write a short note on the power to prohibit mass drill, mass training etc. under the Kerala Police Act, 1960.
8(b) What is the penalty for extortion and for obtaining any bribe under the Kerala Police Act, 1960?
9(a) Enumerate the items which are included in the expression 'forest produce' under the Kerala Forest Act, 1961.
9(b) What kinds of timber are deemed to be property of Government under the Kerala Forest Act, 1961?
10(a) Define 'ragging' in educational institutions.
10(b) Explain the term 'deemed abetment' under the Kerala Prohibition of Ragging Act, 1998.
11(a) State the provisions regarding the arrest of the offender, search and seizure of contraband liquor, vehicles under the Abkari Act, 1077.
11(b) Explain the procedure to be followed after the arrest of a person and seizure of article under the Abkari Act, 1077.
12(a) What does the expression 'public meeting' mean under the Kerala Prevention of Disturbances of Public Meetings Act, 1960?
12(b) What are the offences defined and the penalty prescribed under the Kerala Prevention of Disturbance of Public Meetings Act, 1960?
13(a) Discuss the matters which are not subject to investigation by the Lok Ayukta and Upa-Lok Ayukta.
13(b) Examin the power of the Lok Ayukta and Upa-Lok Ayukta relating to the payment of compensation to the complainant.
14(a) What kinds of animals are included under the definition of 'cattle' in the light of the Kerala Cattle Trespass Act, 1961?
14(b) What are the duties of Pound Keepers under the Kerala Cattle Trespass Act, 1961?
